messages:
oncall-bot: [ALERT] sev2: embed-service request queue spike > p99 latency threshold (4.2s). Paging @mike oncall, @sara infra, @lee runtime. Link: https://alerts.redwood/alert/1934567890 :rotating_light:

mike: seeing the surge. jumping on prod. scaling ded-pool by +2 GPUs now. i’ll tail logs and kv-cache metrics.

sara: i can confirm lots of 503s from gateway -> embed-service, looks correlated with a large batch job from a single customer (cust-phi) at 00:12 UTC.

lee: which commit is live? any recent runtime changes to batching/kv eviction?

mike: deploying v2.14.3 ~11:50 UTC changed batching window default from 20ms -> 40ms (PR #1209). reverting to previous immediately if we think it's causal.

ana: (from support) customer PHI noticed 45% failed requests between 00:11-00:18 UTC. ticket #2048 opened, customer asked for ETA.

mike: quick mitigation: 1) scale pool +2 (started) 2) flip batching window back to 20ms for active servers 3) enable fallback model routing for latency-sensitive routes. doing 2 now via rolling restart.

lee: logs show a spike in KV cache misses around 00:10 that coincides with the batch job. eviction patterns look unusual — maybe a cache pressure bug combined with larger batches. sending log snippet: ```
[00:10:58] warn kvcache: evicting prefix 0x7fbf... (size>threshold)
[00:11:02] error runtime: async tokenization timeout
```

mike: rolling restart applied to 4/8 replicas; request latencies dropping to ~800ms p99, errors down to ~2%.

ops-bot: incident_status: mitigation_in_progress. incident_owner: mike. severity: sev2. impacted_customers: cust-phi (high), a handful of other PLG trials (low).

james: thanks for the rapid response. can we confirm whether autoscaler failed to add nodes earlier? graph shows a 40s delay between CPU threshold and instance spin-up.

mike: autoscaler logs show throttled API calls to cloud provider due to rate limiting; we got 429s when requesting more capacity. fallback to burst buffer (warm reserved instances) helped after ~30s.

sara: note: cloud provider rate limit is a recurring theme. action: request higher quota and add protective backoff logic in autoscaler (assigned to me).

mike: containment achieved at 00:24 UTC. Impact window ~00:10-00:24. telling support team to update cust-phi.

ana: sending a canned update to customer now: "we identified a transient capacity and cache pressure issue triggered by a large internal batch; mitigation applied, services stable. We’ll follow up with a post-incident report and timeline."

mike: proposing post-incident review tmrw 15:00 UTC. agenda: timeline, root cause, action items, rollbacks, alerting tuning. who can attend?

lee: i’ll join. i’ll bring KV cache traces and eviction heuristics.

sara: i’ll present autoscaler logs and quota findings.

james: product/CS rep from my side can join to discuss customer comms.

mike: ok scheduling invite for 2026-03-16 15:00 UTC (calendar: Incident Postmortem — embed-service spike).

mike: immediate action items (from this thread):
- "A1: produce initial incident timeline and publish to docs" — owner: mike — due: 2026-03-17
- "A2: autoscaler quota request + backoff + retry improvements" — owner: sara — due: 2026-03-24
- "A3: restore batching config tests and add e2e test for large batch jobs" — owner: lee — due: 2026-03-30
- "A4: alert tuning: add direct customer-impact alert when error rate > 5% for 5m" — owner: james — due: 2026-03-22
- "A5: support comms: finalize customer-facing timeline and compensation note" — owner: ana — due: 2026-03-18

mike: adding these to the incident board (kanban) and linking ticket #INC-1934567890. will track in weekly remediation sync.

ops-bot: action_items_created: A1,A2,A3,A4,A5. tracker_url: https://boards.redwood/incidents/INC-1934567890

mike: quick retro notes: what went well: fast detection via p99 alert, solid triage. what didn’t: deploy changed batching without load test coverage; autoscaler rate-limit brittle.

lee: prevention patterns: add a synthetic large-batch workload during canary window; validate KV cache eviction under high churn.

sara: add cloud quota watch in infra runbook and pre-warm reserved instances for scheduled heavy jobs.

mike: org-wide shareout: propose a 45m brown-bag next week to walk through incident timeline, KV cache internals, and autoscaler hardening. proposed presenters: lee (cache), sara (autoscaler), mike (ops runbook). preferred dates?

james: Friday 2026-03-20 16:00 UTC works for product & SRE.

ana: support team can make it; would be useful to include a comms playbook.

mike: booked brown-bag: 2026-03-20 16:00 UTC — "Lessons from overnight embed spike: caching, autoscaling, and alerts". calendar invite sent.

sara: i’ll create a short checklist for runbook updates and link in the brown-bag slides.

lee: i’ll prepare a small repro and a demo of the eviction fix.

mike: closing notes: incident contained and monitored. postmortem scheduled. action items assigned and tracker created. thanks all for the rapid handoff and clear comms. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: incident_status: resolved. closed_by: mike. closed_at: 1934568134.
